cards.typed_words:
Established in April, 1985, The Middlesex County Driving Under the Influence of Liquor (DUIL) Program provides an alternative to incarceration for the O.U.I. offender. It is a 14-day residential treatment program consisting of individual and group counseling, education, physical fitness and an introduction to self-help programs.

To date, we have served over 16,200 clients from 35 District Courts throughout Massachusetts.

The program is founded upon the premise that alcoholism is a treatable disease and that the majority of O.U.I. second offenders suffer from this illness.

The program provides a structured environment at a minimum security level in which clients experience clear boundaries and limits on their behavior. Prescribed standards of conduct and restrictions of freedom are intended as a means of self-discipline in the hope that clients will learn to establish appropriate boundaries in other social settings once discharged from the program.

The total cost of the program is $812 at $58/day. Payment plans are available if a client cannot pay in one lump sum. Such an arrangement increases the total cost of $880.

Over 40 hours of substance abuse and mental health education is provided, including extensive coverage of HIV/AIDS issues as they relate to substance abuses.

Each client is seen individually at least four times and participates in a minimum of 27 hours of group therapy.

*Each client will be assigned to an outpatient aftercare agency for follow-up treatment. If a client's probation officer assigns them to aftercare prior to attending D.U.I.L. the client will continue at that agency upon discharge*.

cards.item_type: NO HOME IN THE TREE YET · HIGH SCHOOL ID AND TRAVEL ITEMS
cards.summary: laminated plastic ID card; printed airline ticket stub with barcode; folded paper tourist map
cards.typed_words: Item 1: Lynnfield High School Identification Card, 93/94 school year. Photo of young man in white/navy jacket. Printed: "JENSEN, THOMAS" with barcode. "LYNNFIELD HIGH SCHOOL, LYNNFIELD, MA. IDENTIFICATION CARD". Name handwritten in blue ink: "Tom Jensen". / Item 2: United Airlines-style paper ticket/boarding stub: "JENSEN/TOM", record locator PBG55SK, barcode 0339KS238637, flight KS 23-86-37, PVMQYJ AEFA90, dated 10OCT14. Route: SFO (San Francisco) via flight UA 477, and BOS (Boston) KS 2701, departure 0825. / Item 3: "San Francisco Visitor Map" - a fold-out tourist street map, "A Smart Phone Friendly Interactive Map! Scan QR Codes for Detailed Info! Includes MUNI Transit & Cable Car Lines," showing Golden Gate Bridge, Fisherman's Wharf, Chinatown, and other points of interest, MapWest brand. Together these items document a Tom Jensen trip to San Francisco (dated October 2014 based on the ticket) alongside his old high school ID.
